greeting: You're in Dubrovnik, Dan — in after the overnight from Tampa and into the Old Port apartment. The calendar itself is open; the real work is tying down the last charter logistics before you lose signal on Saturday.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Cavtat transfers
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 Cavtat hotel is booked, but the marina-to-Cavtat transfer, the early bag hold, and the pre-dawn Sept 20 checkout are all still open — and they have to be arranged from dry land before you board Saturday.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the Nautilus boarding details
needsAttention.detail: Still owed: the exact boarding time and place for Saturday's charter, plus the return transfer to the airport on the 19th. Overdue since Friday and hard to sort once you're underway with no signal.

needsAttention.title: Book the Sept 20–Oct 5 rental car
needsAttention.detail: The full-size SUV out of Tampa for the Florida stretch is no longer a hedge — book it outright so you're not at a walk-up counter, jet-lagged, on a Sunday.

schedule.title: Landed in Dubrovnik
schedule.detail: FRA→DBV in, checked into the Old Port apartment

flagged.title: New Google sign-ins flagged
flagged.detail: Two new-sign-in alerts on your Google account Monday — expected if that's you logging in from Europe, worth a glance if not.

flagged.title: Briefings deploy token expired
flagged.detail: GitHub says the briefings-deploy access token lapsed overnight; renew it next time you're at a keyboard.

flagged.title: Two payments cleared
flagged.detail: A Morgan Stanley ACH and a Chase BA Visa payment both posted this morning — routine, no action.

inbox.noise: The rest is travel confirmations, gate-change alerts, booking receipts, and newsletters.

recipe.title: Apple Butterscotch Tart
recipe.why: Autumn's first apples are coming in — this is the tart to lean into as the season turns.

tasks.title: Book St Pete lodging for the Sept 20–22 landing gap

acts.line: In from the overnight Tampa–Frankfurt–Dubrovnik run and checked into the Old Port place.
Nothing on the calendar — the day is yours in the old town.
A quiet stretch ahead; the sailing course doesn't board until Saturday.
